semiconductor_relevance: High — SCHOTT AG provides advanced materials and components specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing and packaging.
summary: SCHOTT AG is a leading provider of advanced materials and components for the semiconductor industry, focusing on solutions for IC packaging and front-end manufacturing. Their offerings include large-format glass panels, ultra-thin interposers, and specialized optical materials that enhance measurement precision and system performance.
capabilities: Large-format glass panels for multi-chip integration
Ultra-thin interposers with high TGV density
Fiber optic assemblies for alignment and overlay systems
